image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a printed restaurant menu lying on a table. The menu features a large, glossy photograph of a food dish (appearing to be a stir-fry or salad with vegetables and protein) in the center. Below the image, there are two columns of text describing menu items, likely in Thai and English, with prices listed. In the background, out of focus, are dining utensils (a knife and fork) and a small portion of another dish or condiment container on the left. The lighting is warm and indoor.

artifact_observations.location: Bottom half of the menu sheet
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text is completely illegible. Characters are malformed, fused, and nonsensical. This is a classic AI generation failure where the model mimics the texture of text without understanding orthography.
The food image has a slightly 'waxy' or over-smoothed appearance typical of AI-generated food photography, lacking fine micro-textures of real ingredients.
The knife and fork in the background have slightly warped geometry and soft, undefined edges that blend into the table surface unnaturally.
